messages:
Nina H: Quick syncproposal: finalize policy execution boundary for smart routing. two options: local client in-router vs central eval with hints. pros/cons?
Omar R: Local is fastest but risky for rollbacks. central is safe but adds ~0.8ms median and high p99 tail.
Priya S: Hybrid seems pragmatic: simple deterministic rules local, heavy tenant-scoped signals central. need a clear DSL flag to mark execution intent.
Ben T: Agree hybrid. Suggest "execution: local|central|hybrid" metadata and a compile-time lint that rejects unsupported signal usage for local.
Nina H: Safety contract: local must implement fail-closed behavior. if a required signal is missing/stale or policy version mismatch -> return SAFE_ROUTE and emit a "policy_fallback" telemetry event.
Omar R: Rollout path: central canary -> local shadow (24-72h) -> staged enable. capture divergence metric per router (percent mismatches) and estimated_cost_delta.
Priya S: Distribution: delta-push over control-plane websocket with seq numbers + pull fallback for flaky edges. sign blobs with KMS.
Ben T: Add CI sim step: run new policy against prerecorded traces to detect mass divergence before allowing local tag. ops-bot: Added dashboard tiles: policy_divergence_rate, local_fallback_rate, avg_local_eval_ms.
Nina H: I'll draft RFC w/ execution metadata, telemetry schema, rollout checklist, lint rules, and a small proto sketch for delta push. comments welcome.
